verdicts.reason: A: 'DEAN COOPER' sits above the white card, and 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' plus the date line are jammed underneath it. The date line hangs off the card's left edge, the card is left as an empty white block with stray pink dots, the white frame sits misplaced below it, and a dead white band fills the bottom. B also leaves an empty card with orphaned dots, the 'R' of 'COOPER' runs onto the busy stripes at the right edge, and the date wraps awkwardly ('AT / 10:00 AM'). Still, B's headline is clearly dominant and its text blocks don't collide, so it is the less broken of the two.
